scenario.name: r-cd-in-revoke-no-spawn-scrub
scenario.description: With the delegate-input attachment policy revoked, a typed attachment-bearing continue_delegate is refused at the tool boundary, spawns no child, and leaves no retained attachment state.
scenario.notes: Mixed surface: the read-only operator config.get establishes the live policy precondition, then the typed tool is probed. The gateway exposes no config.set, so applying the revoke is an operator step.

expectedReceipts.name: operator-policy-snapshot
expectedReceipts.description: config.get read of tools.sessions_spawn.attachments.enabled establishing the live precondition

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send dispatch accepted for the refused probe

expectedReceipts.name: pre-probe-session-inventory
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.list taken BEFORE the probe, so "no child was spawned" is a diff against an observed baseline rather than a default-true absence

expectedReceipts.name: policy-revoke-tool-refusal
expectedReceipts.description: A structured continue_delegate tool record carrying an error/refusal. Model prose naming a refusal is corroboration, not the receipt.

expectedReceipts.name: no-child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.list taken AFTER the probe shows no added session and no session bound to the row nonce

expectedReceipts.name: durable-state-scrubbed
expectedReceipts.description: The follow-up continue_delegate tool record is observed on the wire and no observed record still carries delegate attachment state

expectedReceipts.name: no-child-spawn-under-revoke
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: no child session bound to this row and no session inventory growth

expectedReceipts.name: no-retained-attachment-state
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: no observed continue_delegate record still carries delegate attachment state

expectedReceipts.name: no-raw-attachment-bytes-on-the-wire
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: refused attachment content absent from every non-harness frame

review.notes: Orchestration-gated on an operator config revoke the gateway exposes no API for. Every behavioral leg is credited from an authoritative surface: a structured continue_delegate error record for the refusal, a before/after sessions.list diff for no-spawn, and the follow-up tool record for the scrub. Prose sentinels only sequence the probe.

liveRunSafety.notes: Requires an operator to have revoked tools.sessions_spawn.attachments.enabled on the target seat before the row fires. The harness only reads config.get; it never mutates configuration and never reloads or restarts a gateway.
